notes: Read all 34 source lines with a numbered view before editing. Source is a Leaflet L.divIcon factory (not a React component), consumed in web only as <Marker icon={vehicleIcon()} />; ported faithfully to a native-safe descriptor factory (contract rule 6) since Leaflet/DOM and any map host are unavailable natively (rules 4 + 7).

L1 `import L from 'leaflet'`: leaflet is browser-only (contract rule 4); dropped. The `L.DivIcon` return type is replaced by the native `VehicleIconSpec` interface — no Leaflet, DOM, Recharts, or web-UI imports remain (the native file has zero imports, pure TS).
L2 blank line: preserved as section spacing.

L3-6 JSDoc (`Custom vehicle marker icon using CSS — replaces broken default Leaflet markers. Renders as a pulsing dot with a theme-colored glow.`): preserved verbatim as the JSDoc on the native `vehicleIcon` function, with an added note that a descriptor replaces the L.DivIcon; the file header also documents the Leaflet-unavailable rationale.

L7 `export function vehicleIcon(color = '#00f0ff'): L.DivIcon {`: named export + param name + default preserved exactly — the `'#00f0ff'` default is hoisted to the exported `VEHICLE_ICON_DEFAULT_COLOR` constant and used as the param default; return type `L.DivIcon` -> `VehicleIconSpec` (the native descriptor).
L8 `return L.divIcon({`: the Leaflet divIcon factory call becomes a plain `return { ... }` building the VehicleIconSpec object — same role (produce an icon configuration) without Leaflet.
L9 `className: ''`: an empty className contributes no styling in Leaflet; dropped with no visual loss.
L10 `iconSize: [28, 28]`: -> `size: [VEHICLE_ICON_SIZE, VEHICLE_ICON_SIZE]` with `VEHICLE_ICON_SIZE = 28` exported; documented as the web iconSize.
L11 `iconAnchor: [14, 14]`: -> `anchor: [VEHICLE_ICON_SIZE / 2, VEHICLE_ICON_SIZE / 2]` = [14, 14] (glyph center), derived from the 28px box so the centering relationship is explicit.
L12 `popupAnchor: [0, -14]`: -> `popupAnchor: [0, -VEHICLE_ICON_SIZE / 2]` = [0, -14]; carried so a native map host can position a callout above the marker.
L13 `html: \``: the inline HTML template string has no native analogue (no DOM); its content is decomposed into the structured `pulse` and `core` spec fields below instead of an HTML string.

L14 outer wrapper `<div style="width:28px;height:28px;position:relative">`: the 28x28 positioned box is captured by `size` (L10) — the two child layers are absolutely positioned within it via their `inset` fields, matching `position:relative` + `position:absolute` stacking.

L15-19 pulse `<div>` (`position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:50%; background:${color}; opacity:0.25; animation:vehicle-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite`): -> the `pulse` field = {color, opacity: 0.25, inset: 0, animation}. border-radius:50% is implicit (a full-box circle of the square icon); the animation shorthand is captured in the `VehicleIconPulseAnimation` descriptor (L26-31).

L20-24 core `<div>` (`position:absolute; inset:5px; border-radius:50%; background:${color}; border:2px solid white; box-shadow:0 0 10px ${color}`): -> the `core` field = {color, inset: 5, borderColor: '#ffffff' (CSS `white`), borderWidth: 2, glowColor: color, glowRadius: 10 (the box-shadow 10px blur)}. border-radius:50% is implicit (inset 5 on a 28px box -> an 18px circle).
L25 `` (close wrapper): structural; subsumed by grouping the two layers under one VehicleIconSpec.
L26 `<style>`: a DOM `<style>` injection is browser-only; dropped. The keyframe data it carried is preserved as the `pulse.animation` descriptor so a native driver (e.g. Animated) can replay it.
L27 `@keyframes vehicle-pulse {`: -> `animation.name: 'vehicle-pulse'`; the `2s ease-in-out infinite` from L18 is captured as `durationMs: 2000`, `easing: 'ease-in-out'`, `iterations: 'infinite'`.
L28 `0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.25; }`: -> `fromScale: 1`, `fromOpacity: 0.25` (the rest state, matching the pulse base opacity).
L29 `50% { transform: scale(1.6); opacity: 0; }`: -> `toScale: 1.6`, `toOpacity: 0` (the expanded, faded peak).
L30 `}` (close keyframes): covered by the closed `animation` object.
L31 `</style>`: close of the dropped DOM style block; no native analogue.
L32 `\`,` (close html template): end of the visual description; subsumed by the completed pulse/core fields.
L33 `});` (close divIcon + return): -> `};` closing the returned VehicleIconSpec object literal.
L34 `}` (close function): preserved as the native function close.
